name.ja: Figure-riseStandard 超サイヤ人トランクス＆超サイヤ人ベジータDXセット
name.en: Figure-riseStandard Super Saiyan Trunks & Super Saiyan Vegeta DX Set

ja: 超サイヤ人トランクスと超サイヤ人ベジータがセットで登場！
• DXセット限定の「気を纏った」新たな成形色で戦闘モードを再現！通常版とは違うカラーリングで、一味違う仕上がりに！
• DXセット限定でクリア台座が1セット付属。劇中バトルの再現がすぐにできる！
en: Super Saiyan Trunks and Super Saiyan Vegeta are now available as a set!
• Reproduce the battle mode with new molding colors that are exclusive to the DX set! The coloring is different from the regular version, giving it a slightly different finish!
• One set of clear pedestal is included in the DX set only. You can instantly recreate the battles in the movie!
